chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from Abi Yusuf from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Amira from Malik ibn A'yan from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever says one hundred times 'La ilaha illallah al-Malik al-Haqq al-Mubeen' (There is no god but Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth, the Manifest), Allah, the Mighty, the Compeller, shall protect him from poverty, comfort the loneliness of his grave, attract wealth, and knock at the door of Paradise.

key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: There is no god but Allah

ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of reciting 'La ilaha illallah al-Malik al-Haqq al-Mubeen' one hundred times?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A‘mal*, this hadith highlights the transformative power of the specific dhikr 'La ilaha illallah al-Malik al-Haqq al-Mubin' (There is no god but Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth, the Manifest). It promises both spiritual solace, such as comfort in the solitude of the grave, and material prosperity, effectively linking divine sovereignty with worldly sustenance and ultimate salvation.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to me by Sa’d b. Abdillah from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah from Abi Yusif from Muhammad b. Abi ’Amira from Malik b. A’yan from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “

If one recites a hundred times 'Laa ilaaha illallaah al-Malik Al-Haqqu Al-Mubeen' (There is no god but Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth, the Manifest), Allah, the Mighty and the Compeller, shall protect him from poverty, dispel his loneliness in his grave, grant him wealth, and open the door to Paradise (for him). ”
